Ta Liang Technology.why: Ta Liang's semiconductor-equipment unit (Ta Liang Smart) sells AOI and metrology for CoWoS, SoIC and FOPLP/CoPoS advanced packaging, and its premium CCD routers serve CPO optical-module boards; its stock benefits as advanced-packaging capacity is built.
Ta Liang Technology.evidence: Ta Liang Sep 2026 deck: product line-up by advanced-package application lists CoW (HBM incoming AOI, wafer underfill AOI), SoIC (CMP pad / step-height metrology) and FOPLP/CoPoS (warpage metrology, AOI); TL Smart 2025 revenue by technology CoWoS 75%, FOPLP 14%, SoIC 11%.

players.product: PCB drilling and routing machines with CCD vision and back-drill metrology (StubMapper TM4), used for AI-server boards and CPO optical-module boards; advanced-packaging AOI and metrology for CoWoS, SoIC and FOPLP/CoPoS through its semiconductor-equipment subsidiary Ta Liang Smart

quarterly_data.signal: Ta Liang Smart (Ta Liang's semiconductor equipment business, spun off as an independent company effective 8/1/26, 100% owned by Ta Liang ahead of a planned listing on Taiwan's OTC market; Ta Liang will retain a majority >60% stake after the IPO) sells advanced-packaging AOI and metrology. quarterly_data.figure: CoWoS 75%, FOPLP 14%, SoIC 11%; OSAT 49%, Foundry 46%, ODM 5%; >60% retained stake after IPO

quarterly_data.quarter: Ta Liang Technology IR presentation: Precision Intelligence for High-Complexity Manufacturing (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ta Liang's premium CCD router serves CPO: sub-25 um bonding-pad precision for 1.6T optical modules (800G optical modules in production at <50 um). The company says premium routing systems are seeing standout demand from the CPO segment, and that its StubMapper (TM4) is the industry's only +/-2 mil precision back-drilling solution, required for AI servers (224G SerDes); one TM4 drives an estimated 5-6 CCD drilling machines.
quarterly_data.figure: <25 um for 1.6T; <50 um for 800G; +/-2 mil; 5-6 units per TM4
